summary: Off-registry git dependency on personal GitHub repo pulled at install time
details: package.json declares a dependency `expo-prepare-probe-c2a16db2` sourced from `git+https://github.com/lordseidon/recon-vps.git#expo-probe-1106-c2a16db2` — a mutable branch ref on a personal GitHub account rather than a registry version range. On `npm install`, npm fetches and installs whatever that ref returns and runs any lifecycle scripts it contains, with no version pin and no integrity check. The shipped index.js is a one-line stub, so the manifest line is the entire published surface and the only on-install effect is resolving that off-registry source. The dependency name is unrelated to any advertised purpose and the repository name (`recon-vps`) is consistent with reconnaissance tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
